_comment: Player levels and trader loyalty (DESIGN.md §10, §15), read by Progression. level_xp: the total experience each level 1-60 needs (index 0 is level 1). The curve is 33,000 x ((level - 1) / 9) ^ 1.68, rounded (to 50 below 10,000, 500 below 100,000, else 1,000): an extracted raid earns about 1,000-3,000 XP (raid.tres, poi.tres) and the quests add about 183,000 over a profile (about 105,000 on the maps open today), so with about 2,000 XP a good raid and the quests done as they come level 10 comes after about 7 raids, 15 after about 18, 25 after about 60, 35 after about 115, 50 after about 230 and 60 after about 340 (DESIGN.md §2.2 has the table; with every map open: 7, 17, 44, 83, 193, 297). loyalty: what each loyalty level above 1 needs with a trader (player level, reputation, roubles spent with them). dollar_rate: roubles a dollar counts as when a dollar purchase adds to money spent. reputation.barter: reputation each barter with a trader adds, up to reputation.barter_cap from barters per trader (quests add the rest; DESIGN.md §10 sums it up per trader).
